visual_base.visual_narrative_log: (1) A baby with short black hair and brown eyes is wearing a grey hooded romper with small dinosaur spikes on the hood. He is chewing on a gold-colored plastic medal while a hand holds the medal for him. The background is a brightly lit indoor space with blurred figures. (2) The scene shifts to a wide shot of a crawling competition. Several babies are on a pink and yellow foam mat. Adults are kneeling at the start and finish lines. The setting is a large hall with red barrier ropes and a crowd of onlookers. (3) A promotional banner for the '2025 Baby Competition' is shown on a stage with speakers and black stands. (4) A young girl with her hair in pigtails, wearing a pink t-shirt, holds up a registration badge 'C022' and smiles widely, showing her teeth. (5) The baby is asleep in a grey carrier, his head resting against a man's chest and covered by a blue polka-dot blanket. (6) Several hands reach into the frame to gently stroke the sleeping baby's forehead and cheeks, attempting to wake him. (7) The baby is now awake and held upright. A man in a black jacket holds a yellow toy in front of him. They are in a crowded area with shopping mall signage visible in the background. (8) A group of people, including a woman in a black hat and mask, cheer and pump their fists in the air toward the baby. (9) The crawling race begins. The baby is placed on the mat at the start line labeled with numbers. A countdown animation appears on the screen. (10) The baby crawls forward on his hands and knees. He stops halfway to look at another baby crying nearby. A man in a beige shirt kneels behind him, pointing forward. (11) The baby continues crawling towards the camera where a girl is waving a toy. (12) At the finish line, the young girl puts a gold medal around the baby's neck. (13) The family, including the father, mother, daughter, and baby, pose for a photo in front of the event banner, holding props and smiling.

(5) [Subtitle]: 比賽開始前.. 參賽者睡著了.. 而且還睡得超熟.. (6) [Subtitle]: 靠眾人之力 終於把碰寶叫起床了. (7) [Subtitle]: 碰寶好棒棒 一下子就清醒了. [Variety]: (現在是男子們的爬行戰術討論). (8) [Subtitle]: 等下爬的時候 就往前爬 一直往前爬就對了. (9) [Subtitle]: 有人擋在前面 就抓住他的腿. [Variety]: 來自叔姨姐們的加油. (10) [Variety]: 準備開戰囉. [Subtitle]: 3. 2. 1. 開始. (11) [Variety]: 笑得好開心. [Subtitle]: 跨出第一步了!. (12) [Variety]: 關心旁邊的人在哭哭. [Subtitle]: 巨蟹座的同理心爆發?. (13) [Subtitle]: 為什麼他也一直哭?. (14) [Subtitle]: 算了, 我要出發了. [Variety]: 加速中. (15) [Variety]: 差最後一步!. (16) [Subtitle]: 雖然沒得名 但完賽禮還是有送獎牌. (17) [Subtitle]: 姊姊說: 「弟弟贏了! 要親自頒獎牌給弟弟!」. (18) [Subtitle]: 碰寶表示: 這是什麼? 可以吃嗎?. [Variety]: 吃金牌?!. (19) [Subtitle]: 沒有得名沒關係. [Variety]: 玩得開心最重要.

narrative_and_purpose.mainPurpose: The video documents a family attending their baby's first crawling competition on Mother's Day. It captures the anticipation, the humorous challenge of waking a sleeping baby, the actual race, and the final commemorative family photo, emphasizing the joy and bonding of the experience.
